title: Head of Quality
text:
Working at Freudenberg: "We will wow your world!" This is our promise. As a global technology group, we not only make the world cleaner, healthier and more comfortable, but also offer our 52,000 employees a networked and diverse environment where everyone can thrive individually. Be surprised and experience your own wow moments.
 
 
Freudenberg Performance Materials is part of the Freudenberg Group and a leading global supplier of innovative technical textiles for a broad range of markets: From apparel, automotive, building materials, civil engineering, energy, filter media, healthcare and to building interiors and more. Join our team and shape the future of innovation with us! Discover our world at www.freudenberg-pm.com.

Durham, NC

On-Site

Freudenberg Performance Materials LP (USA)

You support our team as

**Head of Quality**
===================

### **Responsibilities**

* Lead, coach, and develop the Quality team, fostering accountability and continuous improvement.
* Maintain the **Quality Management System (QMS)** and ensure compliance with **ISO and IATF standards**.
* Drive continuous improvement using **Lean, Six Sigma, and quality tools** to improve product and process performance.
* Partner cross-functionally to integrate quality standards across product development and operations.
* Identify and mitigate quality risks while ensuring regulatory and internal compliance.
* Serve as the key quality contact for customers and internal stakeholders, resolving concerns and supporting customer satisfaction.
* Monitor **quality KPIs and performance metrics**, providing insights and recommendations to leadership.

### **Qualifications**

* Based in **Durham or Asheville, NC**, with ability to travel to the sister location **one week per month**.
* 3+ years of **quality experience**, including hands-on technical quality and quality systems management.
* 3+ years of **people leadership experience**.
* **Proven experience managing and overseeing operations across two or more sites.**
* IATF experience/certification and Lead Auditor qualification are strong pluses.
* Strong communicator with confidence, urgency, and the ability to influence others.
* Experience in nonwovens/textiles, medical, pharmaceutical, or automotive manufacturing preferred.
* Bachelor’s degree required; Engineering or Business preferred.
